name: partly-ruling-16-changed-bits-outside-the-held-window
reference: spec 0.52 ruling 16: the bits of a `when ... as <k>` line whose key the entity holds count as bits that key wrote; the first window writes the high nibble 1 for x; the second writes 0x15: the bits that change, the low nibble, are no held key's (y is absent)
